# StudentNeed

> StudentNeed is a campus-only marketplace for students to find, sell, lend, donate, exchange, or request college-essential items within their campus community.

StudentNeed initially focuses on MIT Campus, Anna University. Its core flow is **Find -> Connect -> Meet**: students browse listings, contact an owner, and arrange an in-person campus meetup. The platform is designed around local campus exchange rather than shipping.

## Main pages

- [StudentNeed homepage](https://studentneed.me/): Overview of the campus marketplace.
- [Marketplace](https://studentneed.me/marketplace): Browse available campus listings.
- [Terms of Service](https://studentneed.me/terms): Platform terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://studentneed.me/privacy): Privacy information.

## Important notes

- StudentNeed is intended for verified students in the supported campus community.
- Listing availability and platform features may change.
- Do not assume online payments, delivery, or other features are available unless the current website explicitly offers them.
